lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: name: to-issues

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: description: Break a plan, spec, or PRD into independently-grabbable issues on the project issue tracker using tracer-bullet vertical slices.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: disable-model-invocation: true

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: # To Issues

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Break a plan into independently-grabbable issues using vertical slices (tracer bullets).

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: The issue tracker and triage label vocabulary should have been provided to you — run `/setup-matt-pocock-skills` if not.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## Process

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ### 1. Gather context

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Work from whatever is already in the conversation context. If the user passes an issue reference (issue number, URL, or path) as an argument, fetch it from the issue tracker and read its full body and comments.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ### 2. Explore the codebase (optional)

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: If you have not already explored the codebase, do so to understand the current state of the code. Issue titles and descriptions should use the project's domain glossary vocabulary, and respect ADRs in the area you're touching.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Look for opportunities to prefactor the code to make the implementation easier. "Make the change easy, then make the easy change."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ### 3. Draft vertical slices

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Break the plan into **tracer bullet** issues. Each issue is a thin vertical slice that cuts through ALL integration layers end-to-end, NOT a horizontal slice of one layer.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: <vertical-slice-rules>

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - Each slice delivers a narrow but COMPLETE path through every layer (schema, API, UI, tests)

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - A completed slice is demoable or verifiable on its own

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - Any prefactoring should be done first

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: </vertical-slice-rules>

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ### 4. Quiz the user

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Present the proposed breakdown as a numbered list. For each slice, show:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Title**: short descriptive name

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Blocked by**: which other slices (if any) must complete first

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **User stories covered**: which user stories this addresses (if the source material has them)

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Ask the user:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - Does the granularity feel right? (too coarse / too fine)

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - Are the dependency relationships correct?

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - Should any slices be merged or split further?

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Iterate until the user approves the breakdown.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ### 5. Publish the issues to the issue tracker

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: For each approved slice, publish a new issue to the issue tracker. Use the issue body template below. These issues are considered ready for AFK agents, so publish them with the correct triage label unless instructed otherwise.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Publish issues in dependency order (blockers first) so you can reference real issue identifiers in the "Blocked by" field.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: <issue-template>

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## Parent

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: A reference to the parent issue on the issue tracker (if the source was an existing issue, otherwise omit this section).

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## What to build

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: A concise description of this vertical slice. Describe the end-to-end behavior, not layer-by-layer implementation.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Avoid specific file paths or code snippets — they go stale fast. Exception: if a prototype produced a snippet that encodes a decision more precisely than prose can (state machine, reducer, schema, type shape), inline it here and note briefly that it came from a prototype. Trim to the decision-rich parts — not a working demo, just the important bits.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## Acceptance criteria

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - [ ] Criterion 1

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - [ ] Criterion 2

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - [ ] Criterion 3

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## Blocked by

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - A reference to the blocking ticket (if any)

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Or "None - can start immediately" if no blockers.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: </issue-template>

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Do NOT close or modify any parent issue.
